Splitting into 4 separate vaults requires a separate funded quill account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the beacon binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Verification alone takes 1 days each. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
